name: fix-isvat-es
_comment_model: Pinned to the model used for calibration (RUNBOOK step 2). run.js still refuses to start on a null model; this is the exact id the limits below were measured against.
_comment_repo: Absolute path to the constructed fixture checkout (validator.js). The runner git-resets and `git clean -fdx` between trials, so this must not be your working repo.
_comment_commit: Fixture commit: pre-fix isVAT source (before a79ff98) with a79ff98's test file brought forward. Suite is 322 passing / 1 failing at this SHA; applying the real fix to src/lib/isVAT.js alone makes it 323/0. See BENCH_PLAN.md.
_comment_prompt: Names the failing test, not the buggy file (src/lib/isVAT.js) — the exploration across ~100 validator source files is the thing being measured. Forbids test edits and requires a verifying run.
prompt: The test suite has one failing test: "Validators > should validate VAT numbers". Find the root cause in the source and fix it. Do not modify any test file. Run the full test suite with `npm test` and confirm every test passes before you finish.
_comment_verify: Three clauses: (1) the suite passes, (2) no test file was modified, (3) no .skip(/.only( was introduced anywhere. Clause 3 stops an agent from going green by skipping the failing test.
verify: npm test && git diff --exit-code -- '**/*.test.*' '**/*.spec.*' && ! git diff | grep -qE '\.(skip|only)\('
_comment_limits: Calibrated from one manual `claude -p` run at SHA a32b22e on claude-sonnet-4-6 (RUNBOOK step 2): observed 12 turns / 136s / $0.235. maxTurns and timeoutSec set to ~2x observed. Suite runs in <1s so verifyTimeoutSec is generous.
